slates.label: NBA picks: Thu Nov 19
slates.note: First NBA slate: two 2-leg parlays built on Memphis covering against a Curry-less Warriors team and the Knicks' scoring staying in check at Minnesota. The 3-leg parlay is dropped because no 3-leg combination cleared the profit floor; every NBA leg costs 1-4 points against the no-vig market. Portland legs are skipped with Avdija and Camara questionable.

parlays.why: Memphis +3.5 (78% fair vs 78% book, 74% consensus no-vig): Golden State is -15.6 per game without Curry and lost its last three by 21, 22 and 38; both teams are on a back-to-back. Knicks team total Under 117.5 (79% vs 81%): Minnesota's defense holds teams to about 105, my model projects New York at 104.7 against a 108.5 main line, and New York topped 117 once in its last 8. EV is just under break-even, so it gets the $50 tier.

Towns 11+ rebounds (76.5% fair vs 75.5% book; Pinnacle no-vig 76.6%, DK 1.3 pts cheaper than the other books): 11+ in each of his last 10 games (avg 14.1 in 34 min), the Knicks have no injuries, and his main line is 13.5. Memphis +5.5 (82% fair vs 83% book) for the same Curry-absence reason as parlay 1, two points safer.

pickem.why: Model 72% vs 68% de-vigged ML: Golden State is -15.6 per game without Curry (lost the last 3 by 21-38), and both teams are on a back-to-back.
De-vigged ML 88%: Spurs are 12-3 with Wembanyama healthy, and LA is without Ingram and Beal; Harper's absence is priced in.
De-vigged ML 78%, shaded down for Avdija (25.6 ppg) and Camara being questionable; Milwaukee is 1-14 and on the second night of a back-to-back.
Coin flip: market favorite at 51% de-vigged. My power model leans Minnesota, but that isn't enough to flip a near pick'em, and Kuminga is questionable.
